name: swarm-routing
description: Skills for building and maintaining the swarm-routing ns-3 protocols (AntHocNet, ARA, BeeAdHoc, Termite, HOPNET) and their org: org-repo (templates via tools/org-sync), fidelity-sheet (a protocol's paper-fidelity sheet via tools/fidelity), protocol-review (the golden rules on a diff via tools/protocol-review), docs-review (README, AI files and docs/ to the org standard via tools/docs-review) pr-shepherd (open PRs from review to merge via tools/pr-status) and lit-search (find new papers and confirm references from free sources via tools/lit-search); ns-3-specific skills carry the ns3- prefix.
